title.en: Artifact Injection to Boost Anomaly Detection in Kidney Single-Cell Omics
title.zh: 用伪影注入增强肾脏单细胞异常检测

lead.en: Learn normal kidney from healthy data, then flag what it cannot explain; one modality is evidence on another.
lead.zh: 从健康数据学习正常肾脏，再标出它解释不了的细胞和区域；用一个模态作为另一个模态的证据。

title.en: Trustworthiness of Hypothesis-Testing Agents on Kidney Omics
title.zh: 肾脏组学上假设验证 agent 的可信度

lead.en: Give agents CKD hypotheses on raw kidney omics with answers built in advance; measure when their verdicts cannot be trusted.
lead.zh: 给 agent 肾脏病假设和原始组学数据，答案事先构造好；测它的结论什么时候不可信。
